messages:
Jordan (Customer): Hey team — after upgrading @redwood/sdk from 1.1.3 -> 1.2.0 our Node service started getting 404s for what used to be /v1/generate. No code changes other than npm install. Anyone seen this?
Sam (Support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact npm version and the minimal repro? also full error payload if you have it.
Jordan (Customer): npm ls @redwood/sdk shows `@redwood/sdk@1.2.0`. repro snippet:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Summarize the release notes' });
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{"error":"endpoint_not_found","message":"/v1/generate not found"}
Sam (Support): thanks — two quick workarounds while we investigate: 1) pin to 1.1.3 (`npm i @redwood/sdk@1.1.3`) or 2) call the new responses endpoint directly (raw curl or fetch). can you try pinning and confirm?
Jordan (Customer): pinned to 1.1.3, redeployed — that fixed it, no more 404s. happy to keep pinned if you want time to debug.
Anna (Eng): FYI @sam @mike — looking at changelog, 1.2.0 removed the legacy /v1/generate adapter and switched to `client.responses.create()` shape. we missed a compatibility shim in the published bundle. this should have been backward compatible.
Mike (SDK): confirmed root cause — package published without the legacy adapter file in the distribution for a subset of architectures, so the client attempted to hit /v1/generate but the runtime client code pointed to a path the control plane doesn't accept, producing 404s. created hotfix branch `sdk/restore-legacy-adapter`. plan: publish 1.2.1 that reintroduces shim and adds CI check.
Anna (Eng): timeline: hotfix + publish ~2 hours, we'll also post a release note and add a deprecation warning in console.
Mike (SDK): short-term toggle: set env `REDWOOD_LEGACY_ADAPTER=true` to enable the compatibility layer if you're using 1.2.0 and cannot pin. example: `REDWOOD_LEGACY_ADAPTER=true node app.js`.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for sdk/restore-legacy-adapter -> publishing 1.2.1 candidate (canary). CI green so far.
Sam (Support): I'll relay the workaround to Jordan and follow up once 1.2.1 is live. Jordan — would you prefer we keep you on pinned 1.1.3 or switch to 1.2.1 canary for testing when ready?
Jordan (Customer): pin works for now. If you post the canary I'll test in staging tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam (Support): great, marking as escalated -> resolved (workaround applied). will update once 1.2.1 is published and we've confirmed no further 404s.
